display_long_description:
A giant hero. A beautiful little world. One very sore loser.
Stoic Stinky placed third in a galactic dance contest. He did not take it well. Now his army is sweeping across the universe, and everyone is going to dance to his rhythm. Everyone except you.
You are Weenie Baneenie: a once-ordinary guy who built a beautiful world and, over 100,000 years, became its enormous hot-dog-shaped defender. See through his eyes, raise both hands, and protect the home you love.
This is tower defense where YOU are the tower.
Unleash palm blasts and lasers as flying enemies pour from the sky. Slam toward incoming threats, watch your front and rear shields, and manage your weapons as the swarms close in. You are powerful. Stinky’s answer is overwhelming numbers.
- Fight with both hands using independently aimed palm blasters and lasers.
- Defend a whimsical world of lush hills, rocky cliffs, and towering skies.
- Face Bo Mellow’s pulse attacks, then hold out against the final horde.
- Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard.
This free single-player demo introduces Weenie’s story and a battle you can replay. It is not the full campaign or the final showdown with Stinky.
Feedback is welcome! Tell us what you enjoyed, what confused you, and what you’d like to see next.
Controllers required. Play seated or standing in place, with right-stick snap turning.
Protect your world. Keep the universe free.
